title: SDS-based DNA extraction method of Sediment
author: Qianyue Ji

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Split 10 g of sediment samples into 1 g aliquots using 2 mL centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Sample Consolidation
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatants from the aliquots and combine all aliquots of each sample.

steps.title: Lysis and Enzymatic Digestion
steps.instruction: Add lysis solution and enzymes to the combined sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL lysis solution (0.1 M NaH2PO4, 0.1 M Na2HPO4, 0.1 M EDTA, 0.1 M Tris-HCl, 1.5 M NaCl, 1% (v/v) CTAB).
Add 100 µL lysozyme (100% (v/v)).
Add 100 µL proteinase k (20% (v/v)).

steps.title: SDS Treatment and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add SDS and incubate the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 870 µL 20% (v/v) SDS.
Incubate at 65 °C for 02:00:00.

steps.title: Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:10:00 at 10000 x g and 25 °C.
Collect the supernatant into a new 2 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the supernatant twice using a phenol, chloroform, and isoamyl alcohol mixture (25:24:1 v/v/v) in equal volumes.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA overnight at -20 °C using isopropanol and sodium acetate.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.6× volume of isopropanol.
Add 0.1× volume of 3M NaAc (pH 5.2).

steps.title: DNA Washing and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Wash the precipitated DNA and resuspend it.

substeps.instruction: Wash the DNA twice with 70% (v/v) ethanol.
Resuspend the final pellet in 100 µL TE buffer (pH 8).

steps.title: Option A: Magnetic Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the manually extracted DNA using DNA Clean Beads.

substeps.instruction: Mix DNA Clean Beads thoroughly and add 2X volume of beads to each sample tube; vortex until suspended.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.
Centrifuge briefly and place on a magnetic rack for 00:05:00 until the liquid is clear; discard the supernatant.
While on the magnetic rack, add 500 µL of 80% ethanol to wash beads and tube wall; wait 00:00:30 and discard supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash. Use a low-volume pipette to remove all remaining liquid, centrifuging briefly if necessary.
Keep on magnetic rack and air-dry beads at room temperature until no wetness, glossiness, or cracking is visible.
Remove from rack and add 50 µL of TE Buffer to elute DNA; vortex until beads are suspended.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.
Centrifuge briefly and place on magnetic rack for 00:05:00 until liquid is clear; transfer 48 µL of supernatant to a new 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Option B: Column Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the manually extracted DNA using an MB Spin Column.

substeps.instruction: Load DNA sample onto an MB Spin Column and centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 00:01:00.
Discard flow-through and repeat loading to ensure all lysate has passed through the column.
Place the MB Spin Column into a clean 2 mL Collection Tube.
Add 500 µL of Solution EA and centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 00:01:00; discard flow-through.
Place column back into the same 2 mL Collection Tube, add 500 µL of Solution C5, and centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 00:01:00; discard flow-through.
Place column into a new 2 mL Collection Tube and centrifuge at up to 16,000 x g for 00:02:00.
Transfer the MB Spin Column into a new 1.5 mL Elution Tube.
Add 100 µL of Solution C6 to the center of the white filter membrane.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 00:01:00 and discard the column.
